purpose: Focused PPSSPP debugger probes for functions most likely to expose safe hook boundaries for the FNR3 overhaul. This profile intentionally excludes audio/UI-only tracing.

probes.why: One-time/low-frequency fight-session construction boundary. Capturing callers and arguments should expose fight initialization and the surrounding lifecycle chain.
Known singleton accessor used by fight totals, judging and options/session code. Call-frequency/caller sampling can identify central fight-loop consumers.
probes.note: Potentially frequent; use condition/sampling rather than unrestricted logging.

probes.why: Proven per-corner boxer selection setter. Useful lifecycle marker and validation that session construction/selection state is understood.
Existing static backlog names this as an attack-power consumer. Caller/backtrace capture can reveal the AI decision-update/action-selection loop.
probes.note: Likely high frequency; do not enable as unrestricted log-only probe.

probes.why: Second attack-power consumer; comparing callers with the first can distinguish decision scoring from action execution.
Backlog anchor for aiPunchesThrown. Caller/callee trace may locate player/AI convergence and hit-resolution bookkeeping.
Known generic fight-stat accessor used for punches thrown/hit/knockdowns. Conditional hits on stat IDs can reveal authoritative stat storage and writers.
Known reader of knockdowns and fight totals. Mostly presentation-facing, but useful as an end-of-fight/lifecycle anchor and for validating authoritative stat values.
Static backlog identifies this as a 3-knockdown-rule path. Capturing state/backtrace around hits should lead backward into health/damage and forward into stoppage logic.
Second 3-knockdown-rule path; useful for distinguishing rule evaluation from consequence/state transition.
Known scorecard aggregation boundary. End-of-round/fight hits can reveal inputs and callers leading to the real per-round scoring routine.

success_criteria: Identify at least one fight lifecycle caller chain suitable for a safe hook boundary.
Identify the authoritative stamina/damage state owner or writer neighborhood.
Bound the AI decision loop from attack-power consumers.
Locate the scoring function beneath/around the scorecard aggregation boundary.
